sentences.en: The freshest watermelon is discovered by knocking on its rind.
sentences.zh: 最鲜美的西瓜是通过敲击瓜皮来判断的。

sentences.en: My daughter likes summer fruits, such as cherries, watermelons and peaches.
sentences.zh: 我女儿喜欢夏季水果，比如樱桃、西瓜和桃子。

sentences.en: There is a watermelon on top of your head.

phrases.zh: 无中生有（比喻做事没有根据）
